convert_dynamicreplica_to_wai: run the dynamicreplica conversion script to convert Dynamic Replica dataset scenes to WAI format with intrinsics and extrinsics
process_dynamicreplica_scene: process a single Dynamic Replica scene into WAI format by symlinking RGB images and converting depth maps to EXR
get_intrinsics_matrix: build a 3x3 pixel-space camera intrinsics matrix from NDC isotropic focal length and principal point values
get_extrinsics_matrix: construct a 4x4 camera-to-world extrinsics matrix in OpenCV convention from rotation and translation viewpoint data
load_16bit_png_depth: load a 16-bit PNG depth map and convert it to a float32 numpy array for further processing
